HOW OUR WORKERS COMPENSATION LAW FIRM HELPS INJURED WORKERS IN THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY AREA

At Franco Muñoz Law, our top-rated workman comp lawyers fight for injured employees across the Bay Area, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.


 

Watch this short video to learn how our workers compensation law firm in California
helps injured employees in the San Francisco Bay Area fight for their legal rights.

1

Get a Free Injury Case Result.

Consultations: Free & Confidential. Call us right after your accident for a complimentary 24/7 no-obligation case evaluation with one of our Injury Lawyers.

2

Provide Details About Your Injury Case.

We'll ask for all the details about your case. Then, we'll decide if you have a valid case & figure out the best plan for you.

3

Keep Our Services Without Paying Anything Upfront.

After our lawyers thoroughly review your case, our office will act as your dedicated point of contact, ensuring your case achieves the best possible outcome.

4

Start Receiving Eligible Medical and Monetary Benefits.

We'll fight for your medical treatment, lost wages, and compensation.

Top Workers’ Compensation Law Firm in California

As a leading Workers Compensation Law Firm in California, Franco Muñoz Law Firm has a proven track record of securing maximum benefits for injured workers across the state. With over 80 years of combined experience, our attorneys have successfully resolved thousands of cases involving workplace accidents and permanent disability claims throughout Northern California. We specialize in helping injured workers secure the maximum workers' compensation benefits they deserve.

Proven Success in Workers’ Compensation Cases

The Franco Muñoz Law Firm maintains a 99% success rate in handling workers’ compensation injury claims. Our legal team has recovered over $257 million in settlements and verdicts for injured workers.

If you need an experienced Workers Compensation Law Firm in California, contact us today.

  • Expertise in California Workers' Compensation Law: Our attorneys stay up-to-date with changes in workers' compensation regulations to provide strategic legal representation.
  • Personalized Legal Support: We work closely with our clients, ensuring they receive dedicated attention from start to finish.
  • No Upfront Costs – We Only Win When You Win: We operate on a contingency basis, meaning you don’t pay any fees unless we win your case.
  • Comprehensive Case Management: From filing claims to appeals, hearings, and settlements, we handle every aspect of your case.

Comprehensive Workers’ Compensation Services

  • Free Case Evaluations: We assess your claim and advise you on the best course of action.
  • Filing & Managing Claims: We handle all paperwork, ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
  • Appeals & Dispute Resolution: If your claim is denied, we aggressively represent you in negotiations and court hearings.
  • Medical Evaluations: We work with top medical professionals to substantiate your claim and ensure proper treatment.
  • Maximizing Settlements: Whether negotiating with insurance companies or fighting in court, we aim to secure the highest possible compensation.

If you’re searching for the best workers' comp lawyer in California, look no further than Franco Muñoz Law Firm. Contact us today for a free consultation.

Call us now at (667) 350-1072 to speak with a top-rated workers’ compensation attorney.

Recognized as Top Workers’ Compensation Lawyers by Super Lawyers Magazine

The Franco Muñoz Firm represents injured workers across Northern California in all types of workplace accidents covered under the California Workers’ Compensation System. With offices in Oakland and Concord, we help hardworking individuals recover the maximum compensation after being injured on the job.

Our workers’ compensation lawyers have over 80+ years of combined experience and a proven track record of securing more than $257 million for injured workers. When you become our client, you receive dedicated legal representation focused on achieving the best possible outcome for your case.

30-Day No Fee Guarantee: We give you the opportunity to consult with our attorneys, evaluate our legal expertise, and determine if we are the right fit for your case before making any commitments.

No Win, No Fee Promise: At Franco Muñoz Law Firm, you don’t pay anything unless we win your case. This ensures that you receive the top legal representation without upfront costs.

We uphold three core values: dignity, success, and service. Our mission is to deliver professional, compassionate legal support while securing the best financial recovery for our clients.

If you have suffered a serious workplace or motor vehicle accident, we will fight for the compensation you deserve. There are no fees unless we win. Call (667) 350-1072 for a free consultation.

AS SEEN ON

When Should You Hire a Workers’ Compensation Lawyer?

Many hardworking employees hesitate to contact a workers’ compensation lawyer after a workplace injury. They often believe handling the process alone is sufficient or that hiring an attorney might complicate things. However, the reality is that workers’ compensation insurance companies prioritize their bottom line—not your well-being. Their goal is to minimize payouts, and without legal representation, you risk receiving far less than you deserve. A skilled workers’ comp attorney ensures you receive fair compensation for medical bills, lost wages, and the long-term impact of your injury. Don’t wait—protect your rights by calling an experienced workers’ compensation law firm today.

A Law Firm That Puts Injured Workers First

After years of working at other workers’ compensation law firms, Franco Muñoz, P.C. was founded with a clear mission—to provide real help and maximize benefits for injured workers. For over two decades, Steve Franco and Rene Muñoz have fought tirelessly for clients, knowing firsthand how a work injury can disrupt lives and financial stability. The workers’ compensation process can be overwhelming, but you don’t have to go through it alone. Our legal team handles every aspect of your case, from dealing with insurance companies to coordinating medical treatment and securing the maximum compensation you deserve. Our goal is to let you focus on recovery while we handle the legal battle.

MEET OUR AWARD-WINNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION ATTORNEYS

Our attorneys are elite advocates, committed to securing the maximum compensation you deserve.

In a workers’ compensation case, the right legal team can mean the difference
between a minimal settlement and recovering the full amount you’re entitled to.

Our award-winning trial lawyers are recognized among the best in the profession,
with many honored by prestigious national, state, and local legal associations
for their excellence in client advocacy and case results.

Whether you need a workers' compensation attorney or a
personal injury lawyer, our team is here to fight for you.
